# React and TypeScript Instructions

Applies only to `src/**/*.{ts,tsx}`.

## Rules
- Use TypeScript strict mode conventions and avoid `any`.
- Keep one component per file and use named exports.
- Define props with explicit `interface` types.
- Name event handlers with the `handleX` pattern.
- Use native HTML elements with an associated `label` when applicable.
- Add `data-testid` in kebab-case to every interactive element.
